surveyed.source: Vertex average of the BAG 0363100012096613 ring (PDOK BAG, CC0) in native east/south metres (scripts/landmarks/wtc-amsterdam-footprints.json, modern-prepare.mjs). Massing from the 3DBAG LoD2.2 roof planes (AHN4 2020) snapped to measured levels and stacked as nested tiers (src/canalRecall/landmarks/roofTiers.ts); Tower Ten (78 m, 2022, after the point cloud) from the PDOK orthophoto roof and 2025 Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas; the Zuidplein wing, the bridge, the wing canopies and the signs from the panoramas (scripts/landmarks/wtc-amsterdam-inventory.json).

attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry: glass curtain-wall towers and podium stacked from the 3DBAG LoD2.2 roof planes (CC BY 4.0) on the BAG footprint (CC0), Tower Ten with its white fins, the brick drums and glass hall of the Zuidplein wing, the glazed bridge, the canopies of tilted wings on V-columns and the WTC name signs, read for proportion only from the Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0), the PDOK orthophoto (CC BY 4.0) and Wikimedia Commons photographs by Ceescamel and MrAronymous (CC BY-SA 4.0).
